description:
Review sensitive data in AI prompts and likely credential exposures in public GitHub repositories.

Redaxa checks prompts for sensitive data and offers redaction before sharing with AI tools. On Windows, Pro and Business include focused local reviews of public GitHub repositories. Redaxa prioritizes likely API keys, tokens and credentials, identifies probable providers, groups repeated matches, separates examples from actionable findings and provides masked, redacted reports. Extended history and dependency scanning remains optional. Findings are possible exposures, not proof that a credential is valid or a complete vulnerability audit.
Redaxa 0.4.4
- A more consistent Ocean workspace, clearer typography and easier-to-read repository findings.
- Simpler Pro and Business pricing with a shared monthly/yearly selector.
- More reliable account sessions during token refresh and temporary service interruptions.
- Repository results retain distinct credentials when repeated matches reach the result limit.
- Updated product explanations and subscription guidance.
Repository checks identify possible exposures; they do not verify that credentials are valid. Review findings before taking action. The matching Chrome extension update also prevents an earlier scan from sending or overwriting a prompt edited afterwards; extension distribution follows the Chrome Web Store review process.
